cues.en: Let's finish up this high level overview of what a data engineer does by describing the three main tasks that they do.
cues.zh: 用三項主要任務，完成資料工程師工作的概觀。

cues.en: One is that they build what we call an ETL pipeline.
cues.zh: 第一，建立所謂的 ETL 管線。

cues.en: Or an extract transform load pipeline.
cues.zh: 也就是 Extract、Transform、Load，擷取、轉換、載入管線。

cues.en: So unlike data ingestion, which simply means moving data from one place to another.
cues.zh: 不同於只是把資料從一處移到另一處的 data ingestion，

cues.en: And ETL pipeline is the idea that a data engineer extracts data that has been generated by all of these systems.
cues.zh: ETL 管線是資料工程師擷取這些系統產生的資料。

cues.en: They extract that data, and then when they extract that data, they transform.
cues.zh: 先擷取資料，接著轉換，

cues.en: The data into a useful form that is into a form that can be loaded into a data warehouse.
cues.zh: 成有用的形式，也就是能載入資料倉儲的形式。

cues.en: So they extract the data.
cues.zh: 所以先擷取資料。

cues.en: They transform the data.
cues.zh: 再轉換資料。

cues.en: And they load it into something like a data warehouse so that the data can be used by the rest of the company.
cues.zh: 最後載入資料倉儲之類的地方，供公司其他部門使用。

cues.en: And they use programming languages like Python, Go Scala and Java to accomplish these ETL jobs or extract
cues.zh: 使用 Python、Go、Scala、Java 等程式語言，完成 ETL 工作，也就是擷取，

cues.en: transform load.
cues.zh: 轉換、載入。

cues.en: So that's the first task.
cues.zh: 這是第一項任務。

cues.en: What's the second one?
cues.zh: 第二項呢？

cues.en: The second one is building analysis tools.
cues.zh: 建立分析工具。

cues.en: You see for us to understand how our company systems work.
cues.zh: 為了了解公司系統如何運作，

cues.en: A data engineer needs to make sure that when any part of the system breaks, we are notified.
cues.zh: 資料工程師必須確保，系統任何部分故障時，我們都會收到通知。

cues.en: So a data engineer allows data scientists, data analysts, business intelligence people to use tools
cues.zh: 讓資料科學家、資料分析師、商業智慧人員使用工具，

cues.en: to a analyze the data, but also to make sure that the system that they've put in place is running correctly.
cues.zh: 分析資料，同時確認建立的系統運作正常。

cues.en: Finally, their third main task is obviously to maintain the data warehouse and data lakes.
cues.zh: 第三項主要工作，當然就是維護資料倉儲與資料湖。

cues.en: That is making sure that everything in there is accessible for other parts of the companies to use.
cues.zh: 確保裡面的所有內容，都能供其他部門存取、使用。

cues.en: So now that we have a high level overview of what a data engineer does.
cues.zh: 現在已大致了解資料工程師的工作。

cues.en: I want to talk about some of the tools that you have definitely heard of in the industry, things like
cues.zh: 接下來想談一些你肯定在業界聽過的工具，例如，

cues.en: Hadoop, Kafka, Apache, Spark, all these terms that are really hard to understand.
cues.zh: Hadoop、Kafka、Apache Spark，這些聽起來很難理解的術語。

cues.en: I'm going to try and give you an overview of this landscape so that next time when somebody asks you, Hey, should we use Hadoop?
cues.zh: 會試著提供整體概觀，讓下次有人問：「我們該用 Hadoop 嗎？」

cues.en: Hey, what's Hadoop for?
cues.zh: 「Hadoop 是做什麼的？」

cues.en: Do we need Kafka?
cues.zh: 「需要 Kafka 嗎？」

cues.en: You'll be able to answer that.
cues.zh: 你就能回答。

cues.en: And after this course, you can go off on your own and actually learn to use these tools if they ever come across in your job.
cues.zh: 課程結束後，如果工作需要，也可以自行深入學習這些工具。

cues.en: Now, this landscape is fast changing.
cues.zh: 這個領域變化很快。

cues.en: There's new tools popping up left, right and center.
cues.zh: 到處都有新工具出現。

cues.en: So my advice to you is that what I'm going to show you over the next couple of videos you don't take as the absolute must know for all data engineers.
cues.zh: 所以接下來幾支影片的內容，不要當成所有資料工程師絕對必須熟知的清單。

cues.en: Instead, know that they exist.
cues.zh: 先知道它們存在。

cues.en: Go and read some of their documentation, some of the information online, but only learn or use them
cues.zh: 閱讀文件與網路資訊，但只有真正有需求時，

cues.en: once the need arises because they're constantly being updated.
cues.zh: 再學習、使用，因為它們一直在更新。

cues.en: And the world of data engineering is really fast paced right now.
cues.zh: 資料工程的發展步調非常快。

cues.en: But with that said, let's nerd out on data in the next couple of videos.
cues.zh: 話雖如此，接下來幾支影片就一起深入玩資料。
